title: EVQ residual decomposition: extraction vs retrieval, offline matcher replay
method: Residual = evq-0806 multi-session rows with rag correct and hybrid_ev_syn wrong. Served agg-block parsed from the row's rendered context; matcher replayed exactly (plainto_tsquery 'english', AND rebuilt as OR, per postgres.chronicle_search) against user-turn sentences of the haystack via bench PG. at-cap block => occurred_at-ASC crowding (retrieval-side); sub-cap + a digit-bearing sentence that matches => the instance was servable had it been extracted (extraction-side).

opus_ceiling_probe.method: For the 7 event-shaped extraction-side rows, the sessions containing matcher-matchable digit sentences were labeled through the Opus-5 shim with the v2 events prompt (CPU only), and each instance sentence checked for a digit surviving into an event description. Instance-sentence lists include noise (any digit sentence that any-term-matches the question), so raw coverage understates gold coverage; see per-row artifact evals/results/evq-opus-probe-0807.json for the qualitative read.
qualitative: Where a probed session held a genuine gold occurrence, Opus under v2 captured it with the quantity verbatim: 'a 440-page book' (2311e44b), 'finished episode 12 of My Favorite Murder' and 'finished around 15 episodes of How I Built This' (f35224e0 - both needed instances), 'had a doctor's appointment at 10 AM' (dd2973ad).
The one structural miss is state-shaped: 'I'm currently on page 250' (2311e44b) is a state, not an occurrence - no events prompt carries it; that row needs the static-fact (cortex) track.
qwen-27b served 0-3 events across whole ~50-session haystacks on these rows, while Opus finds 1-3 well-formed events per single probed session: the gap is extractor capacity, not the prompt.

conclusions.retrieval_exonerated: 0/18 residual rows hit the 30-event cap and every row's needed instance sentences pass the exact any-term matcher; the preregistered next probe (chronicle_search matching) is measured dead before any GPU was spent on it.
conclusions.extraction_capacity_is_the_bottleneck: 14/18 rows are sub-cap with matcher-matchable instances absent from the bank; the Opus ceiling probe shows the v2 prompt captures these instances when the extractor is strong enough - the measured fix is the events-pass sidecar LoRA trained on the banked Opus labels (distill-events-opus1.jsonl), already queued.
conclusions.block_authority_churn: All 3 primary-gate losses are the answerer trusting a fuller-but-still-partial events block as exhaustive (counting 4 because 4 are listed; totaling 3 of 4 items); the hedged hybrid_ev_hdr header rescued none of them and flips zero multi-session rows - the textual hedge is measured-insufficient, so any anti-suppression fix must be answerer-instruction- or serving-policy-side, and needs its own preregistration.
conclusions.state_shaped_remainder: The audited not-event-shaped rows (7) plus state-shaped instances inside otherwise-event rows (e.g. current-page progress) are outside events' reach by design; they belong to a static-fact aggregation track (cortex sets), unchanged from the audit's bound.
